signals.title: Claude Code aligns permission UI with the exact grant scope
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 将权限界面与实际授权范围对齐
signals.summary: Claude Code v2.1.235 fixes a permission-comment keyboard path that could approve an edit and grant session-wide edit permission, and changes permission dialogs so displayed scope and 'don't ask again' choices match what a grant would actually cover; persistent approval is withheld when contents cannot be fully displayed.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.235 修复了权限评论框中的键盘路径会误批准编辑并授予会话级编辑权限的问题，同时要求权限对话框显示的范围与“don't ask again”选项严格对应实际授权范围；当内容无法完整展示时不再提供持久授权。

signals.title: Claude Code rejects oversized cross-session messages before delivery
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 在跨会话交付前拒绝超大消息
signals.summary: Claude Code changes SendMessage to reject payloads that exceed cross-session delivery limits before accepting them, replacing silent downstream drops with explicit admission failure at the sender boundary.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 将 SendMessage 改为在接受消息前检查跨会话交付上限，超限即显式拒绝，用发送端的准入失败替代下游静默丢弃。

signals.title: Codex binds header authentication to allowed ChatGPT workspaces
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 Header 身份认证绑定到允许的 ChatGPT 工作区
signals.summary: Codex validates externally supplied header credentials against managed workspace restrictions using the credential-bound chatgpt-account-id, rejects missing or disallowed account IDs including on refresh, and does not replace previously cached authentication with a disallowed refreshed credential.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 使用与凭据绑定的 chatgpt-account-id 将外部 Header 凭据校验到受管工作区限制；缺失或不允许的 Account ID（包括刷新后的凭据）都会被拒绝，并且不会用不允许的新凭据覆盖此前缓存的合法认证。

signals.title: Codex constrains child-agent roles to authority-preserving overrides
signals.title_zh: Codex 将子 Agent 角色限制为不扩权的配置覆盖
signals.summary: Codex limits agent-role customization to supported behavior fields and capability reductions while preserving parent-owned permissions, providers, endpoints, MCP servers and managed requirements; resumed agents use the same bounded role path and symlinked user role files are rejected.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 将 Agent Role 自定义限制在受支持的行为字段和能力收缩范围内，同时保留父会话拥有的权限、Provider、Endpoint、MCP Server 与受管要求；恢复后的 Agent 也使用同一受限路径，并拒绝符号链接形式的用户角色文件。

signals.title: Codex Guardian fails closed when risk scoring cannot complete
signals.title_zh: Codex Guardian 在风险评分失败时执行 Fail-closed
signals.summary: Guardian V2 now treats configuration, serialization, thread-lookup and classification failures as elevated risk, tracks asynchronous scoring failures separately, and falls back to strict approval review instead of retaining a stale low-risk decision when the latest action cannot be scored.
signals.summary_zh: Guardian V2 现在把配置、动作序列化、线程查询和分类错误视为高风险，并单独记录异步评分失败；当最新动作无法评分时回退到严格审批，而不是沿用陈旧的低风险结果。

signals.title: Codex MCP hooks execute only against ready policy-admitted tools
signals.title_zh: Codex MCP Hook 仅对已就绪且通过策略准入的工具执行
signals.summary: Codex routes mcp_tool hooks through the session MCP runtime but restricts them to already-connected, cataloged and policy-allowed tools; unavailable servers fail immediately without startup or reconnect, hook timeouts are capped by server timeout, and recursive hook dispatch is suppressed.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 通过会话共享 MCP Runtime 执行 mcp_tool Hook，但仅允许已连接、已进入 Catalog 且通过策略的工具；不可用服务器直接失败，不触发启动或重连，Hook 超时受 Server Timeout 上限约束，并禁止递归 Hook 调度。

signals.title: Codex separates asynchronous user-visible messages from model context
signals.title_zh: Codex 将异步用户可见消息与模型上下文分离
signals.summary: Codex adds an async root-agent user-message path that emits user-visible text and immediately returns accepted so the turn can continue while keeping that update out of model input context; companion delivery metadata is preserved through event conversion, history and replay.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 新增 Root Agent 的异步用户消息路径：消息向用户可见并立即返回 Accepted，使当前 Turn 可继续运行，同时不把该更新重新注入模型输入上下文；配套 Delivery Metadata 会贯穿事件转换、历史物化与回放。

signals.title: Codex binds reusable execution approval to the actual shell executable
signals.title_zh: Codex 将可复用执行审批绑定到真实 Shell 执行器
signals.summary: Codex evaluates unfamiliar shell executables alongside parsed inner commands and includes the executable in reusable approval keys, so trust in an inner command cannot implicitly authorize an arbitrary shell binary; custom shells require their own approval identity.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 在统一执行审批中同时评估陌生 Shell 执行器与解析后的内部命令，并把执行器纳入可复用审批 Key；因此对内部命令的信任不能隐式授权任意 Shell 二进制，自定义 Shell 必须拥有自己的审批身份。

signals.title: Google ADK fences relayed agent output as untrusted data
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 将 Agent 间转发输出围栏化为不可信数据
signals.summary: ADK now wraps relayed text, thoughts, tool arguments and tool results between explicit markers with a preamble that identifies them as data rather than instructions; marker strings inside payloads are elided first so relayed content cannot structurally close its own quoted block, while maintainers explicitly note this raises the barrier rather than guaranteeing model obedience.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 现在把 Agent 间转发的文本、思考、工具参数和工具结果放入显式 Marker，并在前言中声明其为数据而非指令；载荷中的 Marker 会先被清除，避免转发内容自行闭合引用块。维护者同时明确说明，这只是提高结构隔离强度，并不保证模型一定服从该边界。

signals.title: MCP TypeScript SDK surfaces token-persistence failure after OAuth refresh
signals.title_zh: MCP TypeScript SDK 在 OAuth 刷新后显式暴露 Token 持久化失败
signals.summary: The MCP TypeScript SDK moves saveTokens outside the refresh-error catch so persistence failures propagate instead of being silently converted into a fresh authorization redirect; this prevents rotating-refresh-token flows from losing the newly issued credentials while the old token has already been invalidated server-side.
signals.summary_zh: MCP TypeScript SDK 将 saveTokens 移出刷新错误的 Catch 范围，使持久化失败直接向调用方暴露，而不再静默转成新的授权重定向；这避免旋转 Refresh Token 场景中服务器已使旧 Token 失效、客户端却又丢失新凭据的破坏性状态。
